action_reads.note: Steam fills the sealed kernel and it trembles (f570-628); at f630 the hull splits into two halves that fold onto the pan while foam blooms out of the kernel volume (f632-700); the starch strut lifts the flake (f718-738) and it launches (f744+).

performance.note: Object performance: anticipation (tremble, bulge), a sharp split, slow bloom, a push-up on the leg and a jump with spin; the steam jet and sound rings land just after the split.

feasible_look.note: At 360x640 (phone-f00673) the riso inks, flake, hull halves, cracked kernel and thermometer readouts read; halftone stays texture, not noise.

suggestions: f628-630: the drawing switches from the cutaway (steam visible) to the closed hull exterior for the split; reads as the hull splitting, but a reviewer may notice the convention change.
The leg strut is narrow at phone size; acceptable because the narration names it, but watch it in playback.
Builder self-inspection only; story, visual and factual reviews must be independent.
sampling_limits: Every second frame of the 228-frame proof plus dense strips and one native 360x640 frame; no playback, no audio.
summary: The hardest shot (pressure, split, foam bloom, leg kick and jump) reads as popcorn forming at phone size. Proceed to the full film.
